eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Siskiyou, CA; at 6:34 PM on AUG 15, 2023 Effective until 2:34 AM AUG 16, 2023. Message from WSLF/CAP.
